reason: Preserve the pinned native corpus while exposing explicit source-backed description/state corrections for review. No finding closure or automatic projection is implied.

items.currentDescription: Verifies asset recognition criteria: past event, resource control, future economic benefits — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
items.proposedDescription: Recognizes an externally supplied asset-recognition assertion. An asset definition check alone is insufficient: explicit relevance, faithful representation and uncertainty assessments are required, subject to applicable specific-section precedence. This recognizer does not determine or post recognition.
items.legacyStateDisposition: ASSET_RECOGNIZED is a legacy assertion label, not proof of recognition criteria; ASSET_REJECTED does not settle later recognition or explanatory disclosure.
items.implementationPolicy: Preserve identities and native events/vectors/folds; apply descriptive correction with regenerated affected metadata and explicit before/after audit

items.currentDescription: Verifies liability recognition criteria: present obligation, economic outflow, reliable estimate — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
items.proposedDescription: Recognizes an externally supplied liability-recognition assertion. Definition, relevance, faithful representation and existence/measurement uncertainty judgments are separate requirements, with applicable specific sections taking precedence. This recognizer does not determine or post recognition.
items.legacyStateDisposition: LIABILITY_RECOGNIZED is a legacy assertion label, not proof of recognition criteria; LIABILITY_REJECTED is not a substitute for specific-section analysis.
items.implementationPolicy: Preserve identities and native events/vectors/folds; apply descriptive correction with regenerated affected metadata and explicit before/after audit

items.currentDescription: Evaluates economic substance over legal form for complex transactions — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
items.proposedDescription: Recognizes an externally supplied economic-substance assertion. Where legal form differs from substance, legal form alone does not faithfully represent the phenomenon; unresolved representation requires evidence and review. This recognizer does not authorize legal form to override substance.
items.legacyStateDisposition: LEGAL_FORM_PREVAILS is retained solely as a legacy identifier and must be interpreted as UNRESOLVED_SUBSTANCE_MISMATCH, never an acceptable accounting policy choice.
items.implementationPolicy: Preserve identities and native events/vectors/folds; apply descriptive correction with regenerated affected metadata and explicit before/after audit

items.currentDescription: Verifies compliance with Third Edition effective date (1 January 2027 with early adoption permitted) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
items.proposedDescription: Recognizes an externally supplied third-edition applicability assertion for annual periods beginning on or after 2027-01-01, or earlier application with required disclosure. Edition, reporting-period and disclosure evidence must be separately verified; this is not full-compliance certification.
items.legacyStateDisposition: PREVIOUS_EDITION_ACTIVE is a historical assertion label; it neither selects an edition automatically nor permits previous-edition application after the effective date.
items.implementationPolicy: Preserve identities and native events/vectors/folds; apply descriptive correction with regenerated affected metadata and explicit before/after audit

items.currentDescription: Enforces required note disclosure when entity early adopts Third Edition — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
items.proposedDescription: Recognizes an externally supplied early-application disclosure assertion. For annual periods beginning before 2027-01-01, third-edition application requires an explicit election and disclosure; missing evidence stays unresolved. This recognizer does not create or verify a disclosure by itself.
items.legacyStateDisposition: STANDARD_EFFECTIVE_DATE is a legacy alternate assertion label; absence of early-application evidence does not prove that the reporting period is effective.
